Yes—B is better if you want later morning starts. A has Studio Monday/Wednesday 8–9:15 a.m.; B moves it to Tuesday/Thursday 10–11:40 a.m. Your shared Monday 10–11:15 a.m. class stays the same.

The tradeoff: B spreads classes across four days instead of three, and Studio ends just 20 minutes before your noon work shifts. Both keep Thursday lab 5:30–6:20 p.m., have no class or work conflicts, and meet your requirements at 13 credits. Neither fully matches your afternoon preference.

Saved Plan A and your current enrollment remain unchanged; B is still only a draft.
